about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Egg and Tomato Congee with Ginger
recipes.summary: Silky rice porridge with soft-set egg, sweet tomato and ginger, a comforting savoury breakfast.
steps: Simmer the rice with the water and ginger for 35 minutes, stirring now and then, until the grains break down into a thick porridge.
Stir in the tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until soft.
Slowly pour in the beaten eggs in a thin stream, stirring gently, and cook for 1 minute until set in ribbons.
Season with the soy sauce and salt, and serve topped with sesame oil and spring onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set and eat the congee hot, with leftover rice porridge refrigerated within 1 hour of cooking.
Use tamari for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Savoury Oat Porridge with Mushrooms and Parmesan
recipes.summary: Creamy stove-top oats cooked in stock and topped with golden mushrooms, spinach and a soft egg.
steps: Simmer the oats with the stock and water for 7 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Cook the mushrooms in the oil in a hot pan for 6 minutes until golden, adding the spinach for the last minute until wilted.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Spoon the oats into bowls and top with the mushrooms, eggs, cheese and pepper.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; avoid runny yolks for pregnant, elderly or immune-compromised eaters.
Not suitable for gluten-free unless certified oats.

recipes.title: Chinese Soy Braised Eggs Breakfast Plate
recipes.summary: Marbled eggs simmered in soy and star anise, served with cucumber and warm rice.
steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until firm, then cool in cold water and tap all over with a spoon to crack the shells.
Simmer the vinegar, soy sauce, star anise, cinnamon, sugar and water for 5 minutes until fragrant, then add the eggs.
Simmer the eggs gently for 15 minutes until the whites are deeply coloured, then leave in the liquid to cool.
Peel and halve the eggs and serve with cucumber and warm rice.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are firm; keep refrigerated in their liquid and eat within 3 days.
Food safety: cool and refrigerate the cooked rice within 1 hour.
Use tamari for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Thai Khai Jiao Fluffy Omelette over Rice
recipes.summary: A crisp-edged, puffy omelette flavoured with fish sauce, served over steamed rice with chilli sauce.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the fish sauce and lime juice until frothy.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat until it shimmers.
Pour in the eggs and cook for 1 minute until puffed and golden underneath, then flip and cook for 30 seconds until just set.
Lift onto the rice and top with spring onions and sweet chilli sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set and refrigerate cooked rice within 1 hour.
Drain the omelette well on paper towel to remove excess oil.

recipes.title: Japanese Tamagoyaki Breakfast Plate
recipes.summary: A layered sweet-savoury rolled omelette with rice, pickled cucumber and miso soup.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the mirin, soy sauce and sugar until just combined.
Oil a small non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in a thin layer of egg, cooking for 1 minute until almost set.
Roll the egg to one side, oil the pan again, add another layer and roll, repeating until all the egg is used and the omelette is firm.
Slice into thick rounds and serve with rice, cucumber dressed with the vinegar and shredded nori.
notes: Food safety: cook the omelette until firm and refrigerate leftover rice within 1 hour.
Use tamari for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Lebanese Eggs with Sumac and Labneh
recipes.summary: Fried eggs sprinkled with sumac and served on labneh with warm flatbread, tomatoes and mint.
steps: Spread the labneh over two plates.
Fry the eggs in the oil for 3 minutes until the whites are set and the edges are crisp.
Slide onto the labneh, sprinkle with sumac and salt and serve with the tomatoes, mint and warm flatbread.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set.
Use thick plain yoghurt if you cannot find labneh.

recipes.title: Spanish Huevos Rotos with Potatoes
recipes.summary: Crisp fried potatoes topped with runny eggs, broken at the table into a pile of golden yolk.
steps: Fry the potato slices in the oil in a wide pan for 15 minutes, turning, until golden and tender, then lift out and season with the salt.
Fry the eggs in the same oil for 3 minutes until the whites are set and the edges are lacy.
Pile the potatoes on plates, top with the eggs and jamon, dust with paprika and parsley, and break the yolks at the table.
notes: Food safety: eggs are best cooked until the whites are set, and avoid runny yolks for vulnerable eaters.
Leave out the jamon for vegetarian.

recipes.title: Swiss Rosti with Fried Egg
recipes.summary: Crisp golden grated potato cake topped with a fried egg and chives.

items: 500 g waxy potatoes, boiled and cooled

steps: Coarsely grate the cooled potatoes and toss with the salt.
Heat the butter and half the oil in a non-stick pan, pack in the potato and press into a cake.
Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes until golden underneath, then slide onto a plate, add the remaining oil and flip back to cook for 8 minutes until crisp.
Fry the eggs in a separate pan for 3 minutes until the whites are set and place on top with the chives.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set.
Cooking the potatoes the day before gives the best crisp.

recipes.title: Irish Boxty with Poached Egg
recipes.summary: Griddled potato pancakes with a poached egg and a spoonful of sour cream.
steps: Grate the raw potatoes and squeeze out the liquid in a clean tea towel until dry.
Mix with the mashed potato, flour, baking powder, salt and milk until a thick batter forms.
Cook spoonfuls in the butter in a pan over medium heat for 4 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Poach the eggs for 3 minutes until the whites are set and serve on the boxty with sour cream and chives.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; avoid runny yolks for vulnerable eaters.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Scottish Porridge with Berries and Honey
recipes.summary: Creamy oats simmered in milk and water, with a warm berry compote and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Simmer the oats with the milk, water and salt for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Warm the berries in a small pan for 3 minutes until they release their juices.
Spoon the porridge into bowls and top with the berries, honey and almonds.
notes: Use plant milk for dairy-free.
Not suitable for gluten-free unless certified oats.

recipes.title: Orange and Ricotta Breakfast Toast
recipes.summary: Crisp toast with creamy ricotta, orange segments, honey and basil.
steps: Toast the sourdough until golden and crisp.
Spread each slice thickly with ricotta.
Arrange the orange segments on top, drizzle with honey and finish with basil and pepper.
notes: Add a squeeze of lemon if the berries are not very sweet.

recipes.title: Grilled Mango Yoghurt Breakfast Bowl
recipes.summary: Caramelised mango cheeks over thick yoghurt with toasted coconut and lime.
steps: Grill the mango cheeks cut side down in a hot dry pan for 3 minutes until charred and caramelised.
Toast the coconut in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden.
Spoon the yoghurt into bowls, top with the mango, coconut, honey and pistachios, and squeeze over the lime.
notes: Use coconut yoghurt for dairy-free.

recipes.title: Pineapple and Coconut Yoghurt Parfait
recipes.summary: Layers of coconut yoghurt, roasted pineapple and crunchy oats, ready in minutes.
steps: Toast the oats and coconut with the maple syrup and cinnamon in a dry pan for 5 minutes, stirring, until golden and crunchy.
Sear the pineapple in a hot pan for 4 minutes until lightly caramelised.
Layer the yoghurt, pineapple and crunchy oats into two glasses.
notes: Make the crunchy oats ahead and keep in a jar for 1 week.

recipes.title: Spiced Pear and Walnut Porridge
recipes.summary: Cinnamon oats cooked with grated pear and finished with toasted walnuts and a drizzle of maple.

items: 2 pears, one grated and one sliced

steps: Simmer the oats with the milk, grated pear, cinnamon and ginger for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Spoon into bowls and top with the sliced pear, walnuts and maple syrup.
notes: Use plant milk for dairy-free.
Not suitable for gluten-free unless certified oats.

recipes.title: Costa Rican Gallo Pinto with Fried Egg
recipes.summary: Rice and black beans stir-fried with onion, capsicum and a splash of Worcestershire-style sauce, topped with an egg.
steps: Cook the onion and capsicum in the oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the beans and Worcestershire sauce and cook for 3 minutes until hot.
Stir in the rice and coriander and cook for 4 minutes until heated through and lightly crisp.
Fry the eggs for 3 minutes until the whites are set and serve on top.
notes: Food safety: use rice cooled and refrigerated within 1 hour, and reheat until steaming hot; cook the eggs until the whites are fully set.
Worcestershire sauce contains anchovies.

recipes.title: Nigerian Akara Bean Fritters
recipes.summary: Light, crisp black-eyed pea fritters fried until golden, a Lagos breakfast served with pap or bread.
steps: Blend the peas, onion, chilli, salt and water to a thick, fluffy paste.
Beat the batter by hand for 2 minutes until it turns light and airy.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 180°C and drop in tablespoons of batter, frying for 4 minutes until deep golden and cooked through.
Drain on paper towel and serve hot.
notes: Keep the batter thick so the fritters hold together.
Serve with a tomato and chilli sauce.

recipes.title: Russian Syrniki Cottage Cheese Pancakes
recipes.summary: Golden pan-fried cottage cheese pancakes served with sour cream and berry jam.
steps: Mash the cottage cheese with the egg, sugar, vanilla and salt, then stir in the flour until a soft dough forms.
Shape into 8 small discs, dusting your hands with flour.
Cook in the butter over medium heat for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Serve with sour cream and honey.
notes: Food safety: cook until the centre is hot and set, as the mix contains raw egg.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Swedish Pytt i Panna Breakfast Hash
recipes.summary: Crisp diced potato, sausage and onion fried together and topped with a fried egg and pickled beetroot.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 6 minutes until just tender, then drain and dry.
Fry the potatoes in the butter in a large pan for 10 minutes until golden and crisp, then add the onion and sausage and cook for 6 minutes until browned.
Season with the salt and divide among plates.
Fry the eggs for 3 minutes until the whites are set and serve on top with the beetroot and parsley.
notes: Food safety: reheat the sausage until steaming hot at 75°C or above and cook the eggs until the whites are fully set.
Use pre-cooked sausage.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Kapusniak Cabbage and Pork Soup
recipes.summary: A hearty soup of cabbage, potatoes, smoked pork and dill.
steps: Simmer the pork ribs in the water with the bay leaves for 30 minutes until the meat is tender, then lift out and shred.
Cook the onion and carrot in the oil with the tomato paste for 6 minutes until soft and stir into the broth.
Add the potatoes and cabbage and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Return the shredded pork, add the salt and serve with dill.
notes: Food safety: reheat the pork until steaming hot at 75°C or above and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Leave out the pork and use smoked paprika for vegetarian.

recipes.title: Romanian Ciorba Radauteana Chicken Sour Soup
recipes.summary: A creamy chicken and vegetable soup soured with vinegar and finished with sour cream and garlic.
steps: Simmer the chicken, carrots, onion, celery and capsicum in the water for 30 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, then lift out the chicken and shred it.
Whisk the egg yolks, sour cream and vinegar in a bowl and whisk in a ladle of hot soup until smooth.
Stir the mixture into the pot off the heat with the shredded chicken and salt until the soup turns creamy.
Serve with garlic and parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and do not boil after adding the yolks; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Garlic is traditionally stirred in at the table.

recipes.title: Bulgarian Bob Chorba White Bean Soup
recipes.summary: A smoky white bean and vegetable soup finished with paprika and dried mint.
steps: Cook the onion, carrots and capsicum in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Stir in the paprika for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes, beans, stock and salt.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the soup thickens.
Stir in the dried mint and serve.
notes: Mash some of the beans for a creamier soup.
Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Serbian Pasulj Smoky Bean Soup
recipes.summary: A thick, smoky soup of white beans, paprika and smoked sausage, a Serbian family staple.
steps: Cook the sausage and onion in the oil for 8 minutes until browned and soft.
Stir in the garlic and paprika, then add the carrot, beans, bay leaves, water and salt.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the soup is thick and the carrot is tender.
notes: Food safety: reheat leftover sausage dishes until steaming hot at 75°C or above.
Leave out the sausage for vegetarian.

recipes.title: Armenian Spas Yoghurt and Barley Soup
recipes.summary: A warm, tangy yoghurt soup with chewy barley and dried mint.
steps: Simmer the barley in the water for 25 minutes until tender.
Whisk the yoghurt, egg and flour in a bowl until smooth, then whisk in a ladle of the hot barley liquid.
Stir the mixture into the pot and simmer gently, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Cook the onion in the butter with the mint for 4 minutes until golden and spoon over the soup.
notes: Food safety: cook the soup until steaming hot and the egg is fully set; do not boil hard or the yoghurt will split.
Not suitable for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Polish Barszcz Clear Beetroot Soup
recipes.summary: A ruby-red clear beetroot broth with garlic and marjoram, traditionally served in a cup.
steps: Simmer the beetroot, carrot, onion and stock for 40 minutes until the vegetables are very tender.
Strain through a fine sieve into a clean pot, pressing lightly.
Stir in the garlic, marjoram, lemon juice, sugar and salt and warm gently, without boiling, so the colour stays bright.
notes: Serve with small mushroom dumplings or bread.
Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Romanian Eggplant Salad Salata de Vinete
recipes.summary: Smoky charred eggplant beaten with oil and onion into a creamy white-pink spread.
steps: Roast the eggplants at 230°C for 45 minutes, turning, until the skins blacken and the flesh collapses.
Peel and drain the flesh in a colander for 15 minutes, then chop finely with a wooden knife.
Beat the flesh with the oil in a bowl, a little at a time, until pale and creamy.
Stir in the onion, lemon juice and salt and serve with tomatoes and parsley.
notes: Use a wooden or plastic knife to keep the colour pale.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Polish Surowka Carrot and Apple Salad
recipes.summary: Crunchy grated carrot and apple dressed with lemon, a touch of sugar and sour cream.
steps: Toss the carrots and apples with the lemon juice straight away to stop browning.
Stir in the sugar, sour cream and salt until evenly coated.
Chill briefly and scatter with parsley.
notes: Serve within a few hours for the best crunch.

recipes.title: Hungarian Tomato and Pepper Salad
recipes.summary: Ripe tomato and sweet pepper in a simple vinegar and oil dressing with onion, a summer staple.
steps: Arrange the tomatoes and capsicums on a platter with the onion.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, sugar and salt together until the sugar dissolves.
Pour over the salad and scatter with parsley.
notes: Best made with summer tomatoes.
